robots_summary: www.wipo.int/robots.txt disallows /edocs/traindocs/, /edocs/lexdocs/, and /edocs/infogdocs/tdc_sony/. HOWEVER, the actual WIPO Lex document PDFs resolve to the path prefix /wipolex/edocs/lexdocs/ (e.g. www.wipo.int/wipolex/edocs/lexdocs/laws/en/cm/cm005en.pdf), which is NOT matched by the bare 'Disallow: /edocs/lexdocs/' rule. The /wipolex/ legislation detail pages and profile pages are not disallowed. wipolex-res.wipo.int/robots.txt returned HTTP 403; wipolex.wipo.int/robots.txt 301-redirects to the www.wipo.int copy. In practice all tested detail pages and PDF URLs returned content (treated as Allowed/fetchable in their canonical /wipolex/edocs/ form).

Explored the guide's tabbed sub-pages (Introduction, Constitution, Legislative, Judicial, General Sources) and extracted the outbound PRIMARY-source links it points to (PRC/Presidency, WIPO Lex, OHADA, National Assembly, Juricaf, Droit-Afrique aggregator, ILO NatLex, Constitute Project). The guides.loc.gov and www.loc.gov hosts returned HTTP 403 to the WebFetch tool (AI/bot user-agent blocking) even though robots.txt does not disallow the guide paths; page contents and outbound links were reconstructed via WebSearch result snippets and by directly verifying the destination sites.
robots_summary: Two hosts. guides.loc.gov/robots.txt: blocks many AI/bot user-agents site-wide (GPTBot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Amazonbot, etc. = Disallow: /); for User-agent: * it only disallows utility scripts (/az.php?, /go.php, /srch.php, /er.php, etc.) — the /law-cameroon guide paths are NOT disallowed and are crawlable by permitted agents. www.loc.gov/robots.txt: User-agent: * disallows /cgi-bin/, /search, /fedsearch, /myloc, etc.; the /law/ and /item/ guide paths are NOT disallowed (Crawl-Delay: 5). Net: the Cameroon guide document paths are Allowed by robots.txt, but the WebFetch tool itself received 403 (bot-blocked), so fetchability via this tool is effectively blocked/JS-gated.

source_explored: Presidency of the Republic of Cameroon (Présidence de la République du Cameroun) — https://www.prc.cm. Explored EN and FR sections: /news/the-acts (Laws, Ordinances, Decrees, Orders, Decisions, Circulars) = FR /actualites/actes; the Constitution page /en/cameroon/constitution = FR /fr/le-cameroun/constitution; and the Joomla media component /multimedia/documents/{id} which serves official PDFs. robots_summary: robots.txt present (standard Joomla). User-agent: * disallows only backend/system dirs (/administrator/, /cache/, /cli/, /components/, /includes/, /language/, /libraries/, /logs/, /media/, /modules/, /plugins/, /templates/, /tmp/). The legal-document paths used here — /en/news/the-acts/*, /fr/actualites/actes/*, /multimedia/documents/* and /files/* — are NOT disallowed. Note: /media/ is disallowed but the served PDFs live under /files/ (allowed), not /media/.

source_explored: Cameroon Ministry of Justice — LEGALIS Cameroon portal (minjustice.gov.cm). HTTPS refuses connections and the legalis.minjustice.gov.cm subdomain does not resolve; the live site is served over plain HTTP at http://www.minjustice.gov.cm and redirects to /index.php/fr/ (Joomla + FLEXIcontent CMS). LEGALIS lives under /index.php/fr/legalis/accueil-legalis with texts organized by type under /index.php/fr/textes-lois/{lois,ordonnances,decrets-pr,decrets-pm,arretes,conventions,amendements,circulaires,decisions,...}. Each document page exposes a direct PDF via a FLEXIcontent download URL of form /index.php/fr/textes-lois/lois/download/{fileId}/{itemId}/18?method=view, which returns Content-Type: application/pdf with bilingual filenames (e.g. PPL00727072005FREN.pdf = FR+EN). The collection actually hosted is small (~30 Lois plus assorted decrees/conventions); no Constitution, General Tax Code, Penal Code base law 2016/007, or Civil Status ordinance was found hosted here. Ordonnances category appears empty.
robots_summary: robots.txt present at http://www.minjustice.gov.cm/robots.txt (standard Joomla default). User-agent: * disallows only CMS system folders: /administrator/, /bin/, /cache/, /cli/, /components/, /includes/, /installation/, /language/, /layouts/, /libraries/, /logs/, /modules/, /plugins/, /tmp/. No Sitemap entry. The legal-document paths (/index.php/fr/textes-lois/... and the /download/... PDF endpoints) are NOT disallowed — Allowed for crawling.
